P_0x005B73: A test pilot in <Project TD>, once run by <DC>, now under Federation control. Headstrong and dreams of becoming an astronaut, enduring harsh training for it. Far below fellow pilot Sleigh in skill, ranked only No.04, but unmatched in enthusiasm.
P_0x005D86: Chief of <Project TD>'s system dev team, keeping it running with backing from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Caring and personable, though capable of cold, rational judgment.
P_0x005EDD: A Vegalion pilot, younger sister of Filio Presty, head of <Project TD>. Fierce and merciless to enemies, with absolute confidence and pride in her own skill.
P_0x005FF9: A bold warrior who lives by his convictions, valuing honor and fair play, if a bit inflexible. An expert in swordsmanship.
P_0x006101: A mysterious figure who secretly aids the Hagane and Hiryu Kai. Calm, proud, and mindful of the greater cause, yet flexible enough to always see the big picture. A genius pilot who calls his unit "Trombe" (German for tornado). Also a noted gourmet and superb cook.
P_0x0062EB: A pilot on the Kurogane, third Space Noah-class battleship. Calm and gentlemanly, he despises cowardice and helps the weak. Fond of tea, particular about brewing and serving it.
